a.lede: Nvidia’s cofounder and chief executive resigned on Thursday after the company opened an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
a.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: Nvidia Board reportedly moves to expel Jensen Huang as stock tumbles on latest scandals and lack of succession plans at Nvidia.
b.title: Nvidia’s Board reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang as second extra-marital affair emerges
